Why NHE

  • Trench to panel, one crew

    Underground electrical usually means two contractors and a scheduling fight. Ours is in-house — we dig the trench, lay the conduit, pull the wire and land it in the panel.

  • Two divisions, one call

    Electrical and excavation under one roof. Homeowners, GCs and builders deal with one company and one schedule for both scopes.

  • Clean, labelled work

    Panels dressed in neat, every circuit labelled, sites left tidy. The next person who opens your panel will know exactly what they're looking at.

  • 24/7 emergency electrical

    Electrical emergencies don't keep business hours, and neither do we. Call (289) 668-5947 any time.

Northern Heavy & Electrical Inc. is owned and operated by Shane Thompson out of Niagara Falls, Ontario. Both divisions — NHE Electrical and NHE Excavation — operate under one roof, so there is one company, one crew and one call from trench to panel.

Backing Our Own

NHE is a proud jersey partner of the Niagara Falls Canucks U9 MD1 — home and away. Local support, lasting impact.
